name: Coco
source:
“Well I’ve got a suggestion, but I don’t want to ruffle any feathers…”

Always at the bottom of the pecking order, Coco nevertheless has a strength of heart that is unrivalled. Quick-witted and ever-cheerful, she’d rather watch from afar than get involved.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/GeniusBishoujo/status/1483424104367673347?s=20&t=bV6EA0oyHTTLY9Z7B6cGHw]official Twitter[/url]]
